name: Belle Époque
kurzbeschreibung: **Welcome to Belle Époque in Ehrwald** Discover the charm of the **Belle Époque** in the picturesque village of **Ehrwald**, nestled in the heart of the **Tirol** Alps. Step back in time as you explore the elegant architecture, refined cafés, and historic ambiance that define this enchanting retreat. Indulge in traditional **Tiroler** hospitality with a visit to our **Kaffeehaus**, where you can savor a steaming cup of coffee or a slice of **Apfelstrudel** while admiring the breathtaking mountain views. For a hearty meal, try our famous **Kaiserschmarrn**—a fluffy, caramelized pancake served with powdered sugar and fresh fruit. In the evenings, enjoy live music and cocktails at our **Belle Époque Lounge**, where the atmosphere blends old-world elegance with modern sophistication. Whether you're here for relaxation, culture, or adventure, **Ehrwald** promises an unforgettable escape into a bygone era of luxury and leisure. **Plan your stay today and experience the magic of Belle Époque in Ehrwald!** --- **Visit us** **Book now**
